saw_lines: Car mats get bought by registration and model, and buyers check fit and trust before they ever compare on price.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where buyers judge fit and trust before clicking.
Your site shows 750,000 customers and 68,344 reviews, yet 0 of 30 live ads use either number. Put 750,000 in the first line of three ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 17 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 750,000 customers and 68,344 reviews, yet 0 of 30 live ads use either number, so cold buyers get no trust signal. Put 750,000 in the first line of three ads and open two with a review quote.
23 of your 30 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, so a shopper who clicked a rubber mat ad has to search again. Point each ad to the exact mat it shows, starting with the custom and rubber ads.
Your 18 copy ads open with 13 different openings, and the biggest opener leads only 2, so no message is repeated enough to be remembered. Pick the two best stories and build the next batch from them.

30 of your live ads have run 60 days or more, and the oldest has been running since January 2025, so you have proof that the message works. Build three more variations of that oldest winner, changing only the opening line.

ads_1: Review-led creative with 750,000 customers up front, tested against the made in UK opener
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
